name: Bakusa ~Chained Heart~
source:
Main character suddenly lost his family in an accident and lost the energy to live. At such time a certain lady appears before him requesting to train a girl as slave. It was very surprising to know that the object of training is his classmate he liked for a long time...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一次事故中突然失去了家人，失去了生活的动力。这时，一位女士出现在他面前，要求训练一个女孩作为奴隶。得知训练的对象是自己喜欢已久的同学，真是太意外了……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
